data.desc: Scage Future (Nasdaq: SCAG) is a Cayman Islands holding company whose operating subsidiaries develop and manufacture new energy heavy-duty commercial vehicles and e-fuel solutions. Headquartered in Nanjing, China, the Company's product portfolio spans battery electric, plug-in hybrid and hydrogen-electric heavy trucks for port, mining, long-haul logistics and agricultural applications, together with SOEC hydrogen production technology.
